campaign_by_campaign.known_divergence: The panel's environment filter goes through the campaign's script results, so a run that failed before starting any script is hidden; Atlas counts it as a failed run.

kpi_radar_stb_tv.known_divergence: The panel groups by the raw variant and action-set id, so a NULL variant and 'Base' (or two action sets sharing a label) appear as separate rows with one label; Atlas merges them into one axis value. Those keys are reported as ambiguous, not compared.
